inputs.tools:
- kaos-source-fr-search: Search the Federal Register for rules, proposed rules, notices, and presidential documents. Supports full-text search, filtering by document type, agency, date range, CFR reference, and docket ID. No API key required.

- ``document_number`` (string, e.g. '2024-23733') — the canonical Federal Register document number. **Use this field when asked for a document number.**

- ``agencies`` — array of agency objects with ``name`` and ``slug``.

When the user asks for the most-recent EPA rule or similar, set ``order=newest`` and read ``results[0].document_number`` + ``results[0].title`` directly. Do NOT claim the response lacks a document number — it is always populated for valid hits.
